title: Python SAN address binding validator
description: Implement the Python leaf-certificate SAN binding checks from R-X509-016/018/051: require exactly one native 0200::/8 iPAddress equal to upstream AddrForKey(subject SPKI), reject zero/multiple/mismatch and forbidden DNS/email/URI names, ignore non-native iPAddress entries, and enforce SAN criticality iff subject is empty. Add independent pyca-backed tests using pinned external certificate fixtures.
close_reason: Implemented Python SAN binding validation for RFC profile: required SAN, subject-dependent criticality, Ed25519 SPKI upstream AddrForKey equality, duplicate/mismatch/forbidden-name rejection, non-native IP ignore; 10 focused tests pass, Ruff and compileall pass. Three Kimi K3 delegated reviews were attempted but unavailable due OpenRouter insufficient credits; local correctness/security/edge fallback passes found no defects.
